_notes: Claude-only matrix for scripts/run_matrix.py through Anthropic's own API with one ANTHROPIC_API_KEY. label becomes the results file name: results/<label>.<split>.json. slug is the Anthropic model id.
batch: true sends each run as one Message Batch at half price. The script submits every batch first and then collects them; most batches finish within an hour and none takes longer than 24 hours.

reasoning_effort: low, medium, high, xhigh, or max. 'none' turns thinking off on Claude Sonnet 5.5 (sent as thinking type between_tools). Claude Opus 5.5 and Claude Fable 5.1 cannot turn thinking off. Without reasoning_effort the API default applies: Opus 5.5 medium, Sonnet 5.5 high, Fable 5.1 high.

max_new_tokens caps the visible answer; the backend adds an effort-scaled thinking headroom on top (4K low, 8K medium, 16K high, 64K xhigh and max). Requests above about 21K tokens are streamed when not batched.
No fallback model is configured: a refusal scores as an empty answer instead of being answered by another model.
prices_usd_per_million are Anthropic's list prices (October 2026) for the estimate. Each result's usage.cost_usd is computed from the same prices and the tokens the API reports, halved for batches.
Fable 5.1 rows are kept disabled for later; set enabled to true (or remove it) to run one.
